comment: Authoring input for scripts/import-cosmetics.cjs. `folder` is a directory in BambooContent/Cosmetics, `slot` is hat|back|cape, `bone` is the player part the mesh is mounted on (bipedHead|bipedBody). `offset` moves the authored model into the player's feet space: x right(+)/left(-), y up, z back(+)/front(-) in model pixels, so the geometry itself already sits where it belongs on the player.
